Snow Removal in Valley East: Questions

Do you clear snow in Val Caron, Val Thérèse and Blezard Valley?

Yes. We cover all of Valley East — Hanmer, Val Caron, Val Thérèse and Blezard Valley — plus Capreol.

Do you remove snow after the city plow passes?

We clear your driveway on our visit. If the city plow comes by later and leaves snow at the end of your driveway, let us know and we'll tell you what we can do.

Can I book snow removal for the whole winter?

Yes. Choose a whole-winter plan or a visit after every snowfall, or call us one storm at a time — whatever suits you.

How fast can you get to Hanmer?

We offer same-day service across Valley East. Call or WhatsApp 705-562-9047 and we'll tell you when we can be there.

Do you do other jobs in Valley East?

Yes — house cleaning, lawn care, moving help, handyman jobs and more. See all our services.
